title: unparseable metadata values do not make a manifest invalid
rationale: version is not semver, homepage and repository are not URLs, author.email is not an email and license is not SPDX. §5.4 forbids rejecting for any of these.
quote: Clients MUST NOT reject a manifest solely because `version` is not valid Semantic Versioning; `homepage`, `repository`, or `author.url` is not a recognized URL; `author.email` is not a recognized email address; or `license` is not an SPDX identifier.
